notes.title: June 24 update
notes.content:
[p]Good morning, everyone![/p][p]Last night, I uploaded a new build of the game and the in-game trophies are now synchronised with the Steam achievements. If you have already unlocked them in your game, however, they will not automatically show up as unlocked on Steam, as the code for synchronisation has now been added. [/p][p]This means that, to unlock the Steam achievements, you must start a [i]new game[/i]. [/p][p](Then you can just... skip!)[/p][p][/p][p]I also fixed some bugs, such as missing sprites (I apologise for not noticing this earlier), and added sounds to some scenes.
[/p][p]Lastly, and perhaps most importantly, [b]corrections to Aiko's English route have finally been added[/b]! (as well as a few to Hikaru's English route)

However, after discussing it with others who have finished the game, we concluded that it's best to start with Hikaru's route to fully enjoy the revelations in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Buuut... even if you start with Aiko's route, I'm sure you'll enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]Follow your heart's desires. ฅ(ᵔ꒳ ᵔマ.ᐟ

Enjoy your continued adventure with [b]Neko No Sentouki[/b]![/p]

notes.title: Note Update 4 May
notes.content:
[b]Adjustments made :[/b]

- Added missing ''side'' sprites in both routes;
- Added missing translation strings in the English translation of Hikaru's route.

The English translation from Aiko's route is not yet complete. I again recommend starting with Hikaru's route.
